messages:
nina_sales: FYI incoming POC request from VerdantCare — they want an hours-only non-preemptible guarantee for their clinical demo week. Theyre proposing a 12mo commit (~$480k). Need pricing + deal desk path.

tom_se: They specifically need guaranteed capacity 08:00-18:00 CET Mon-Fri for 10 GPUs during POC. Thats peak demo traffic, otherwise low off-hours.

claire_dealdesk: Key questions: (1) exact GPU count (10?) (2) region (eu-west-1?) (3) will they accept scheduled maint windows? Also need to know if burst autoscaling allowed outside demo hours.

arthur_finance: For a 12mo $480k commit in eu-west, non-preemptible carveout uplift usually ~20% on reserved baseline. We can offer 14% uplift if they provide monthly spend schedule and commit to no early termination.

mei_eng_ops: Ops notes: Non-preemptible carveout reduces scheduler efficiency and impacts KV cache collocation. We can do 10 GPUs in eu-west but lead time ~7 business days. Need infra ticket with exact time windows.

nina_sales: Customer accepts a short maintenance window (max 3 hours / month) and will sign SOW amendment. They also want explicit fallback removed for POC.

contract_bot: Draft clause suggestion: "Provider will allocate non-preemptible dedicated GPU capacity for agreed demo windows. Scheduled maintenance (<=3 hours/month) excluded. Failure to meet availability results in credits per service terms."

claire_dealdesk: Proposed next steps: (A) @nina send finalized GPU count + region by EOD; (B) @mei open infra ticket with this manifest: ```yaml
pool: dedicated_nonpreempt
region: eu-west-1
gpus: 10
window: '08:00-18:00 CET Mon-Fri'
autoscale: limited
fallback: none
```
(C) @arthur produce uplift memo for exec approval. If uplift <=15% we can approve in deal desk; >15% needs CRO signoff.

arthur_finance: Will run numbers and post recommended uplift by tomorrow morning.

nina_sales: Thanks all, Ill confirm and loop back. :white_check_mark:
